label: Live animals

label: Wheat
definition: This group comprises all the varieties of unmilled wheat.

label: Canola (including rapeseed)
definition: This group comprises canola and rapeseed.

label: Fresh fruit, nuts and vegetables, and pulse crops
definition: This group comprises fresh fruit, nuts, and vegetables, and pulse crops.

label: Other crop products
definition: This group comprises crop products n.e.c.

label: Other animal products
definition: This group comprises animal products n.e.c.

label: Fish, crustaceans, shellfish and other fishery products
definition: This group comprises fish, crustaceans, shellfish and other fishery products, live and dead, except processed beyond frozen or dressed.

label: Logs, pulpwood and other forestry products
definition: This group comprises wood logs, pulpwood and other forestry products.

label: Crude oil and bitumen
definition: This group comprises conventional crude oil, crude and diluted bitumen, and synthetic crude oil.

label: Natural gas
definition: This group comprises natural gas, a mixture of gaseous hydrocarbons consisting primarily of methane.

label: Natural gas liquids (including condensate) and related products
definition: This group comprises natural gas liquids (NGLs) and related products. NGLs are found in natural gas and include liquefied petroleum gases or LPGs (propane, butane), ethane, lease condensate, pentanes plus, among others.

label: Coal
definition: This group comprises coal, a combustible black (hard coal) and brownish-black (brown coal) rock consisting of more than 50% by weight and more than 70% by volume of carbonaceous material. It is formed from plant remains that have been compacted, hardened and chemically altered, and metamorphosed by heat and pressure over geologic time.

label: Nuclear fuel and other energy products
definition: This group comprises nuclear fuel, and fuel wood, fuel products of waste wood, other solid fuel products n.e.c.; and steam and heated or cooled air or water.

label: Electricity
definition: This group comprises all forms of generated electricity.

label: Natural gas distribution
definition: This group comprises natural gas distribution services through mains.

label: Iron ores and concentrates
definition: This group comprises iron ores and concentrates.

label: Copper ores and concentrates
definition: This group comprises copper ores and concentrates.

label: Nickel ores and concentrates
definition: This group comprises nickel ores and concentrates.

label: Radioactive ores and concentrates

label: Other metal ores and concentrates
definition: This group comprises other metal ores and concentrates.

label: Waste and scrap of metal

label: Waste and scrap of plastic and rubber

label: Waste and scrap of glass
definition: This group comprises waste and scrap of glass.

label: Potash
definition: This group comprises potash.

label: Stone, sand, gravel, clay, and refractory minerals
definition: This group comprises stone, sand, gravel, clay, and refractory minerals.

label: Diamonds and other non-metallic minerals (except cut gemstones)
definition: This group comprises diamonds and other non-metallic minerals, except cut gemstones.

label: Prepared and packaged seafood products
definition: This group comprises prepared, processed beyond dressing, and packaged seafood products.

label: Meat products

label: Dairy products
definition: This group comprises dairy products.

label: Animal feed
definition: This group comprises animal feed.

label: Intermediate food products
definition: This group comprises intermediate food products such as cooking oils, flour and sugar.

label: Other food products
definition: This group comprises other food products such as breakfast cereal, bread, chocolate and snack food products.

label: Coffee and tea
definition: This group comprises coffee and tea.

label: Frozen, fresh and canned fruit and vegetable juices
definition: This group comprises frozen, fresh and canned fruit and vegetable juices.

label: Carbonated and non-carbonated drinks (including low alcohol fermented drinks), bottled water and ice
definition: This group comprises carbonated and non-carbonated soft and other drinks, including low alcohol fermented drinks, bottled water and ice.

label: Alcoholic beverages
definition: This group comprises alcoholic beverages such as beer, wine, brandy, whisky and other distilled liquor.

label: Tobacco products (including electronic cigarettes)
definition: This group comprises tobacco products (including electronic cigarettes).

label: Cannabis products
definition: This group comprises cannabis viable seeds and vegetative plants; fresh and dried cannabis (buds and leaves); cannabis oil; other cannabis extracts and concentrates; cannabis-infused edible products; and other cannabis products n.e.c., for non-medical (recreational, wellness, lifestyle, spiritual, etc.) and medical uses. A plant of the genus Cannabis refers generally to three varieties which are cannabis Sativa, cannabis Indica and cannabis Ruderalis. Sativas and Indicas are the most commonly used cannabis strains for cultivation and propagation. The genetics of the different cannabis strains are widely mixed or cloned to create cannabis hybrids. Cannabis contains a number of active elements, including cannabinoids such as tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) or dronabinol, cannabidiol (CBD) and terpenes (aromatic compounds or chemical markers). Cannabis plants containing 0.3% w/w (weight for weight) of THC or less in the flowering tops and leaves - industrial hemp - and their derivatives with the THC concentration of 10 µg/g or less, as well as prescription drugs or pharmaceuticals containing cannabis, are excluded from this group.

label: Fabric, fibre and yarn, and leather and dressed furs
definition: This group comprises fabric, fibre, yarn and thread, and leather and dressed furs.

label: Clothing, footwear and accessories
definition: This group comprises clothing, footwear and accessories.

label: Refined petroleum energy products (including liquid biofuels)

label: Asphalt (except natural) and asphalt products
definition: This group comprises asphalt, except natural asphalt, and asphalt products.

label: Dyes and pigments, and petrochemicals

label: Lubricants and other petroleum refinery products
definition: This group comprises lubricants and other petroleum refinery products.

label: Basic chemicals

label: Fertilizers, pesticides and other chemical products

definition: This group comprises cleaning products and toiletries.

label: Other unwrought non-ferrous metals and non-ferrous metal alloys
definition: This group comprises other unwrought non-ferrous metals and non-ferrous metal alloys.

definition: This group comprises commercial and service industry machinery and equipment.

definition: This group comprises other general-purpose machinery and equipment, n.e.c.

definition: This group comprises parts of industrial machinery and equipment.

definition: This group comprises communication, and audio and video equipment.

definition: This group comprises medical, measuring, and other electronic and electrical machinery and equipment.

definition: This group comprises aircraft engines, aircraft parts and other aerospace equipment.

definition: This group comprises parts of railway rolling stock and of other transportation equipment.

definition: This group comprises wood millwork, and wood products n.e.c.

definition: This group comprises plastic and foam building and construction materials.

label: Prefabricated buildings and components thereof
definition:
This group comprises prefabricated buildings that are built in a factory or manufacturing facility and delivered to the construction site, and the components of prefabricated buildings built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated (factory-built) buildings are virtually complete and either unassembled or fully assembled (or manufactured) and ready to use; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

A building refers to any roofed independent free-standing permanent construction or structure usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof and comprises one or more rooms or other space. A building can be entered or accessed by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building can also include a separately usable underground construction.

A residential building refers to a construction in which at least half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for residential or dwelling purposes.

A non-residential building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for non-residential purposes.

label: Fabricated metal products
definition: This group comprises fabricated metal products.

label: Packaging materials
definition: This group comprises packaging materials.

label: Miscellaneous goods and supplies
definition: This group comprises miscellaneous goods and supplies.

label: Published products and recorded media (except software)
definition: This group comprises books; newspapers; periodicals; other published products; recorded music and other sound recordings and recorded movies, television programs and videos. The published products can be acquired or accessed on a physical form or media, or online. They are published on own account for sale by the publishers. Wholesaling and retailing services are excluded from this group.

label: Software and software licensing
definition: This group comprises published software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), and licences to use software or software components to generate revenues.

label: Transportation of commodities by pipeline
definition: This group comprises transportation of natural gas, crude oil, refined petroleum products and other commodities by pipeline.

label: Freight transportation by road
definition: This group comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles (including rental and leasing with operator or driver), for general and specialized freight.

label: Other freight transportation services and air specialty services
definition: This group comprises transportation services (including rental and leasing with operator or crew) such as rail, water and air freight; moving services; and air specialty services.

label: Postal and courier services
definition: This group comprises postal services; and courier, parcel, and local messenger and delivery services.

label: Passenger transportation services (including sightseeing)
definition: This group comprises urban transit services; taxi and limousine services; interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services; school bus services; other transit and passenger transportation services by road; rail passenger transportation services; water passenger transportation services; air passenger transportation services; and scenic and sightseeing tour services. Rental and leasing services of passenger vehicles with operator, driver or crew are included.

label: Transportation support services
definition: This group comprises road transportation support services; motor vehicle maintenance and repair services; rail transportation support, maintenance and repair services; water transportation support, maintenance and repair services; air transportation support services; aircraft maintenance and repair services; freight transportation arrangement and customs brokering services; and other transportation support services.

label: Warehousing and storage services
definition: This group comprises grain storage services and warehousing and storage services for other goods.

label: Wholesale services (except commissions)
definition: This group comprises the services of buying and selling merchandise on own account at an intermediate step in the distribution chain. Wholesale services bundled with services incidental to the own account sale of merchandise such as logistics, inventory management, marketing services, packaging and labeling, handling of warranty claims, in-store or co-op promotions, and product training are also included.

label: Wholesale trade commissions
definition: This group comprises the services of arranging the buying or selling of merchandise for others on a commission basis at an intermediate step in the distribution chain.

label: Retail services (except commissions)
definition: This group comprises the services of buying and selling merchandise on own account at the final step in the distribution chain, and rendering services incidental to the retail sale of merchandise; the services are provided in-store, on-line or in vending machines.

label: Retail trade commissions
definition: This group comprises the service of selling and renting merchandise for others on a commission basis at the final step in the distribution process.

label: Repair and maintenance services (except for buildings and transportation equipment)
definition: This group comprises repair and maintenance services, except for buildings and transportation equipment. Covers maintenance and repair services for commercial and industrial machinery and equipment; maintenance and repair services for electronic and precision equipment; and maintenance and repair services for personal and household goods.

label: Rental and leasing (except rental of real estate)
definition: This group comprises rentals and operating leases of motor vehicles (except with operator or driver); computer equipment; office furniture and equipment; communication equipment, commercial and industrial machinery and equipment (except with operator); and other goods.

label: Residential buildings
definition:
This group comprises residential buildings.

A residential building refers to a construction in which at least half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for residential or private dwelling purposes, whether on a permanent basis or not. Residential buildings normally provide accommodation units or residential building units with self-contained and exclusive use of bathroom and kitchen facilities to the occupants of each unit. At least half of the useful floor area must be used or intended for dwelling units, in the case of apartment buildings. A residential building unit is a structurally separated and independent place.
A group of three row houses that are attached is considered to be three separate buildings if their external walls or dividing walls extend from the foundations to the roof.

Residential buildings constructed entirely at the building site, as well as on-site fully assembled precast, panelized, modular and other prefabricated residential buildings are included in this group. Unassembled prefabricated residential buildings built in a factory, and manufactured or fully assembled residential buildings built in a factory and delivered ready for move-in, are excluded from this group.

A building for which the majority of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for dwelling units with shared bathroom and kitchen, or that area is used primarily to offer care and other assisted living services, is classified as a "collective dwelling-type building" under the non-residential buildings group.

A building refers to any independent free-standing permanent structure comprising one or more residential dwelling units, business units or other spaces. A building can be entered by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building is covered by a roof and is usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof. In the case of interconnected structures (e.g., semi-detached or terraced houses), any unit separated from other units by a fire wall extending from roof to cellar is considered an individual building. If there is no fire wall, the interconnected building units are regarded as individual buildings if they have their own access (own entrance) as well as their own utility system and are separately usable.

label: Non-residential buildings
definition:
This group comprises non-residential buildings.

A non-residential building refers to a construction in which more than half of the overall useful floor area is used or intended for non-residential purposes, namely for industrial, commercial or institutional purposes, including for the provision of services. A non-residential building unit is a structurally separated and independent place.

Non-residential buildings constructed entirely at the building site, as well as on-site fully assembled precast, panelized, modular and other prefabricated non-residential buildings are included in this group. Unassembled prefabricated non-residential buildings built in a factory, and manufactured or fully assembled non-residential buildings built in a factory and delivered ready for move-in, are excluded from this group.

A building for which more than half of the useful floor area is used or intended for dwelling units or accommodation units with shared bathroom and kitchen, or that area is used primarily to offer care and other assisted living services, is classified as a "collective dwelling-type building" in this group.

A building refers to any roofed independent free-standing permanent construction or structure usually enclosed within external walls or dividing walls that extend from the foundations to the roof and comprises one or more rooms or other space. A building can be entered or accessed by persons or animals and is suitable or intended for protecting them and objects. A building can also include a separately usable underground construction. In the case of interconnected structures, any unit separated from other units by a fire wall extending from roof to cellar is considered an individual building. If there is no fire wall, the interconnected building units are regarded as individual buildings if they have their own access or entrance, as well as their own utility system and are separately usable.

label: Civil engineering works
definition: This group comprises civil engineering works (infrastructures) or construction works other than buildings and their associated site works, comprising a structure, such as highways, bridges, pipelines, nuclear power plants, water filtration plants and mine structures (except buildings). Construction works are also the results of operations such as dredging, dewatering or soil stabilization.

label: Industrial intellectual property
definition: This group comprises industrial intellectual property, such as patents and industrial designs, produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

label: Originals protected by copyright
definition: This group comprises originals protected by copyrights produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

label: Oil and gas and mineral exploration
definition: This group comprises certain services used in the search for, discovery and initial delimitation of previously unknown pools of oil or gas, unproven areas or deeper zones of known pools, previously unknown mineral deposits, or the re-evaluation of sub-marginal or neglected mineral deposits.

label: Research and experimental development services
definition: This group comprises research and experimental development services in natural sciences, engineering and technology, medical and health sciences, agricultural and veterinary sciences, social sciences, and humanities and the arts. Research and experimental development (R&D) comprise creative and systemic work undertaken in order to increase the stock of knowledge - including knowledge of humankind, culture and society - and to devise new applications of available knowledge. The term R&D refers to three types of activity: basic research, applied research and experimental development. Basic research refers to experimental or theoretical work undertaken primarily to acquire new knowledge of the underlying foundations of phenomena and observable facts, without any particular application or use in view. Applied research refers to original investigation undertaken in order to acquire new knowledge. It is, however, directed primarily towards a specific, practical aim or objective. Experimental development is systematic work, drawing on knowledge gained from research and practical experience and producing additional knowledge, which is directed to producing new products or processes or to improving existing products or processes.

label: Custom software design and development services
definition: This group comprises software specifically designed and developed for an individual customer, and customization of existing software to meet the specific needs of the customer.

label: Licensing of rights for commercial use of non-financial intangible assets (except products protected by copyright)
definition: This group comprises licences for the use of non-financial intangible assets, except assets protected by copyrights, to generate revenues.

label: Support and custom work services for agriculture, forestry, hunting and fishing
definition: This group comprises support services for crop production; support services for animal production, hunting and fishing; support services for forestry; and custom work services for forestry.

label: Mining and oil and gas support services
definition: This group comprises support services for mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction, except exploration.

label: Construction services
definition: This group comprises construction services for buildings and engineering works.

label: Manufacturing services
definition: This group comprises fabric weaving and finishing services; printing support services; contract printing services; coating, engraving, heat treating and similar metal processing services; and custom manufacturing services, except printing, and finishing of textiles and metals.

label: Advertising space and time
definition: This group comprises provision of advertising space in newspapers, periodicals and other printed publications, provision of advertising air time on radio and television, and Internet advertising.

label: Advertising, public relations, and related services
definition: This group comprises exclusive advertising rights, endorsements, and display advertising; advertising intermediary services; direct advertising services; full-service advertising campaigns; advertising creative services; advertising services n.e.c.; and public relations services.

label: Audio and video production services
definition: This group comprises audio recording services, copyright administration services, and audiovisual production, post-production and editing services.

label: Licensing of rights for commercial use of products protected by copyright (except software)
definition: This group comprises licences for the use of intellectual property protected by copyrights, except software, to generate revenues.

label: Telecommunications, broadcasting distribution and related services
definition: This group comprises fixed wholesale and retail telecommunications services; fixed wholesale and retail Internet access services; mobile wholesale and retail telecommunications services; cable, satellite, Internet and other fixed or mobile broadcasting distribution services of audiovisual and audio works; and online games, except gambling.

label: Other information technology (IT) and information services
definition: This group comprises data processing, hosting and related services, and other information technology (IT) and information services.

label: Financial services (except insurance)
definition: This group comprises financial system regulatory services; account and cash management products; loans and other credit financing products; investment products; financial planning services and trust products for individuals, businesses, institutions (except unincorporated) and governments; and products supporting financial services.

label: Pension and life insurance products
definition: This group comprises pension and annuity products; and life insurance products.

label: Other insurance services
definition: This group comprises health and accident insurance products; vehicle and property insurance products; other non-life insurance products; reinsurance products; and insurance brokerage and other services related to insurance.

label: Real estate services
definition: This group comprises residential rents; rooming and boarding services; non-residential rents; and real estate brokerage and other services related to real estate.

label: Legal and accounting services
definition: This group comprises legal services; and accounting, tax preparation, bookkeeping and payroll services.

label: Architectural, engineering and related services
definition: This group comprises architectural services; engineering services; surveying and mapping services; and other services related to architecture and engineering.

label: Specialized design services
definition: This group comprises interior design services; interior decorating services; industrial design services; graphic design services; and fashion, jewellery and footwear design services, and other design services n.e.c.

label: Computer systems design and related services (except software development)
definition: This group comprises computer network design and development services; computer systems design, development and integration services; information technology (IT) technical consulting services; and information technology (IT) technical support services.

label: Management, scientific and technical consulting services
definition: This group comprises management consulting services; environmental consulting services; and other economic, scientific and technical consulting services.

label: Other professional services
definition: This group comprises photographic services; veterinary services; and other professional, scientific and technical services.

label: Administrative and support services
definition: This group comprises office administrative services; employment services; business support services; security and investigation services; services for buildings and dwellings; and facilities and other support services.

label: Water, sewer and waste management services
definition: This group comprises water delivered by water works and irrigation systems; sewage and dirty water disposal and cleaning services; and waste management and remediation services.

label: Health services
definition: This group comprises various health practitioner services, and medical laboratory, hospital, ambulance and other health care services.

label: Residential and nursing care, social assistance, and child day-care services
definition: This group comprises residential and nursing care, social assistance, and child day-care services.

label: Education services
definition: This group comprises education, instruction, training programs and services. Also covers sports coaching services.

label: Sport and live performance services
definition: This group comprises contract production of live performing arts performances, live sporting events, and copyrighted works; sport and performing arts event organization services; career management and representation services of artists, athletes, entertainers and other public figures.

label: Admissions to events, performances, exhibitions, and recreational and heritage institution services
definition: This group comprises admissions to live sporting events, live performing arts performances and motion picture film exhibitions, as well as recreational services and heritage institution services.

label: Gambling (net wagers)
definition: This group comprises lotteries; table wagering games; gambling machine products; racing and sporting event gambling products; and Internet gambling products.

label: Prepared meals and beverages
definition: This group comprises prepared meals; and alcoholic beverages for immediate consumption.

label: Traveller accommodation
definition: This group comprises room or unit accommodation services for travellers; and recreational vehicle park and recreational camp services.

label: Travel arrangement, reservation and planning services
definition: This group comprises reservation services for passenger transportation, cruises, lodging, pre-packaged tours and events; event ticket sales and reservation services, and access to global distribution systems; trip planning services; packaged tours; and other travel arrangement and reservation services.

label: Personal and personal care services
definition: This group comprises hair care and aesthetic services; funeral services; laundry, dry-cleaning and related services; parking services; and other personal and personal care services.

label: Babysitting and other private household services
definition: This group comprises babysitting services and private household services.

label: Membership organization services
definition: This group comprises provision of services by organizations to members, in exchange for membership dues and similar payments.

label: Public administration services
definition: This group comprises services of a governmental nature, that is, services related to the enactment and judicial interpretation of laws and their pursuant regulations, and the administration of programs based on them. Services provided by government that are not governmental in nature are classified to the same service categories as equivalent services provided by the private sector.
